notes.title: Language Update + 50% discount!
notes.notes:
Hello there BUTCHER fans!

It's been quite some time since the last update, so we decided to let you know about 2 things that have been recently going on with BUTCHER.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26094784/cf50d0a6210bf1403bb1bad660adce8be765e00b.jpg[/img]

Firstly - the game is now being handled by [url=http://crunchingkoalas.com]Crunching Koalas[/url], a publishing studio responsible for porting and bringing BUTCHER to consoles. The guys at Transhuman Design were pretty happy about our work, so they decided to trust us even more and hand the PC version of the game over to us. Not much will change, maybe besides you seeing BUTCHER more often, but if you ever wanted to contact us about the game, feel free to:
[list][*]post your messages on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/474210]BUTCHER's community hub[/url]
[*]send us [url=mailto:support@crunchingkoalas.com]e-mails[/url]
[*]ping us at [url=https://twitter.com/CrunchingKoalas]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/crunchingkoalas/]Facebook[/url][/list]

Secondly - we decided to update the game and add some new languages! Our fast-paced blood-soaked love letter to the classics of the genre is now available in:
[list][*]German
[*]French
[*]Spanish
[*]Portuguese[/list]
To celebrate the update, we also decided to cut the price of the game in half, for the next 7 days, so don't hesitate and get it right now!

Cheers,
Crunching Koalas

notes.title: Level Editor with Steam Workshop Update
notes.notes:

Do you think that there's still not enough violence in BUTCHER? Do you want to release your inner psychopath, but locking people in the basement for real is not your thing? Do you feel like you just lack proper tools?

Then guess what, that's good news for you!

A huge BUTCHER update has been released! Level editor with Steam Workshop support has been added, which gives you access to stuff not used in the base game:

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: [BETA] Level Editor Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/d582a2a8f02e55efee7ff400e1a1f7d9b0aaa9fb.jpg[/img]

I have to admit it. I lied.

[b]I told everyone I didn't want to implement Steam Workshop features. But guess what, it's done now.[/b]

The editor is still available only in the BETA branch, but it will change soon.

The problem was that the native Steam wrapper I used crashed the game on callbacks and I needed to write my own lib to deal with it.

[b]Leaderboards changes in BETA branch[/b]
It's now possible to see how your friends performed in each (official) level.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/48b8de255d71fa33cb50cb01a5e3a4be1af20fee.jpg[/img]

The score histogram has been changed as well. The worst scores (i.e. worse than average minus 2 seconds) are now ignored, making it readable and meaningful.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/fa157d2b764bf6266bf087f6f0faff142bd007e7.jpg[/img]

Expect more small updates coming soon.

notes.title: BUTCHER W.I.M.P. (EASY MODE) DLC RELEASE
notes.notes:
Do you feel overly frustrated with [b]BUTCHER[/b] and just want to murder like a tank?

We've got a surprise for you!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/46ae2ea7deb5a59e824842f79de9973b92f1251d.png[/img]

BUTCHER W.I.M.P. (Winning Is My Pleasure) is an easy mode DLC that will allow you beat levels [b]only[/b] for the price of losing your dignity (if you have no dignity already, you lose nothing!).

[strike]Also, BUTCHER is [b]20% OFF[/b] on that occasion![/strike] (special offer ended)

Warning! Side effects might include:
[list]
[*]Depression
[*]Lower self-esteem
[*]Socially inappropriate behavior caused by the loss of self-respect
[*]Feeling offended
[*]Sleep disorders
[/list]

Also, we've recently added the following features:
[list]
[*]Better gamepad support (especially XBox and DS4 on Windows)
[*]Key combo support in controls settings
[*]Scoreboards for speedrun high-scores
[*]Multiple save files
[*]Compatibility tweaks and minor bugfixes
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TZW3IzjrlEY

notes.title: Leaderboards and gamepad update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/5d586820797b0088e32764609b8899d6ce49f10a.gif[/img]

We're happy to announce that we've just moved all beta features to the live production version, including better gamepad support and speedrun leaderboards!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Better gamepad support:
   [list]
   [*]Supported gamepads and operating systems (the list might grow in the future) - if not on the list, it might work, but no guarantees (we have no way to test everything, especially on non-Windows platforms):
      [list]
      [*][b]Windows 7:[/b] XBox 360 (wired and wireless), XBox One, DS4, Logitech F310
      [*][b]Linux (Ubuntu 16.04, default driver):[/b] Xbox 360 (wireless)
      [*][b]OSX:[/b] Logitech XUSB, DS3
      [/list]

      [*]Slight auto-aim and rebindable gamepad layout.
      [*]Advanced settings for unrecognized gamepads (or not recognized  properly) - old "experimental" section.
      [*]Possibility to turn off gamepad menu navigation in cases of improperly recognized gamepads.
      [*]Possibility to change dead zones for walking and jumping.
      [*]No keyboard layout select popup if gamepad is used in-game.
   [/list]
   [*] Combo keys support - just press 2 or more keys in the key config prompt.
   [*] Multiple save files.
   [*] Speedrun leaderboards (or rather scoreboards) - you can beat levels again as fast as possible and compare your scores against others.
   [*] Level browser is accessible regardless of the progress of the game.
   [*] Fixed: shader compatibility issue that caused low framerate in rare cases.
   [*] Fixed: black screen issue (fix worked on Windows 8.1 and integrated Intel GPU).
   [*] Fixed: city 4 end-arena elevator bug.
   [*] Fixed: city 3 lighting didn't work properly from time to time.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/f693db362e56f293f019cedc72b798a2023b610d.gif[/img]

Also, we've prepared a new [b]easy mode DLC[/b] for people who aren't tough enough to enjoy the normal version of Butcher. Stay tuned for more info!

So go ahead, sit on your comfy couch and watch your victims lie in a pool of blood for days before they die from hunger or raging infection, whatever gets them first.

notes.title: Bugfixes and more...
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce a new small update!

Changes:
[list]
[*]Added: an option to clean-up all gore each time you respawn (Settings -> Video).
[*]Fixed: smoke effects are now below the player and enemies to improve readability.
[*]Fixed: not working skull achievements.
[*]Fixed: being able to go outside of the map in jungle, level 1.
[*]Fixed: railgun ignored picking up ammo when charged.
[*]Fixed: grenades (and likely other window-breaking projectiles) could tunnel through wall if shot through overlapping breakable window.
[*]Fixed: level browser menu impossible to navigate with gamepad.
[*]Fixed: slight sound tweaks here and there.
[/list]

In other words, nothing should hinder you from squeezing the last drop of blood and feces out of your screaming enemies.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/710577438d78a2127f364293e980c9da7a88196d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Small Butcher update
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback and people streaming the game, we were able to prepare a small update that makes the game a bit more friendly towards newbies:

[list]
[*]Added more places to hide, more ammo packs and balanced the number of more difficult enemies in Ironworks Facility levels.
[*]Added options to turn off HUD health feedback (hurt noise and low HP warning overlay) for people who don't like it
[/list]

Make sure Steam updates the game on your machine and have fun making your enemies drown in their own blood before they bleed to death.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/e8e1f391355234230b7d4dd927457592a813c786.jpg[/img]
